schema_note: One entry per (sport, market). status is one of: EXHAUSTED, READY_FOR_OUTCOME_DISCOVERY, PARTIALLY_EXPLORED, BLOCKED_BY_HISTORICAL_DATA, BLOCKED_BY_LIVE_DATA, REQUIRES_NEW_INFORMATION, UNEXPLORED. outcome_prediction_status and betting_backtest_status are tracked as SEPARATE axes per Phase 4 Section 8/20 -- a market can be READY on one axis and BLOCKED_BY_HISTORICAL_DATA on the other.

markets.best_estimator: market consensus probability (no fundamentals model beats it)
markets.calibration_status: DONE -- market well-calibrated across probability bands
markets.sealed_holdout_status: DONE -- 2024_25 fold, market wins on every metric
markets.betting_overlay_status: EXHAUSTED -- no persistent inefficiency found; conditioning on market probability collapses winner/loser feature differences to near-zero
markets.live_support: LIVE -- production Daily Bet Card already scans this market
limitations: 2025_26 season not yet run through the acquisition/feature pipeline (raw files present, unprocessed)
fundamentals cannot beat market probability once conditioned on it
markets.next_action: Do not spend further Claude research cycles on 1X2 outcome-prediction with the current feature set. Revisit only if a genuinely new information source becomes available (e.g. team news, lineups, live in-play data).

markets.outcome_prediction_status: READY -- Stage A complete this cycle (Gate 1b)
markets.betting_backtest_status: BLOCKED_BY_HISTORICAL_DATA -- historical panel is only 2-3 bookmakers per match, below production's min_bookmakers=3 floor; cycle_002_consensus_ou25.csv is 0 bytes
markets.best_estimator: market (thin-panel, research-grade) -- log_loss 0.6755 pooled vs fundamentals 0.6867 vs market+fundamentals 0.6806 vs naive 0.6964
markets.calibration_status: DONE -- fixed-band calibration report produced (CALIBRATION_BANDS.csv); market best-calibrated overall (ECE 0.0117 vs fundamentals 0.0185 vs naive 0.0454)
markets.sealed_holdout_status: DONE -- 2024_25 fold; market still best (log_loss 0.6796 vs fundamentals 0.6909 vs naive 0.6933); not a fully blind prospective holdout (raw seasons reused across cycles) but a genuine first look for this target
markets.betting_overlay_status: BLOCKED_BY_HISTORICAL_DATA for retrospective backtest; prospective/live scanning already possible since the outcome-prediction model needs no historical odds panel to train
markets.live_support: READY -- fundamentals features and live odds quotes are both obtainable pre-kickoff; not yet wired into production
limitations: Historical bookmaker panel too thin (2-3 books) for a production-grade consensus; only research-grade thin-panel average available
2025_26 season not yet in the feature pipeline
No feature-stability (season-by-season coefficient drift) analysis run this cycle -- only performance metrics
markets.next_action: Market alone remains the strongest O/U2.5 estimator; no fundamentals model justifies production deployment yet. Recommend: (a) begin preserving raw per-bookmaker O/U2.5 quotes prospectively for a future thicker panel, (b) do not build a betting overlay from historical data, (c) move to the next market (BTTS) for the next Stage-A-only cycle rather than re-working O/U2.5.

markets.betting_backtest_status: UNEXPLORED -- historical odds depth not yet audited for this market
markets.data_family: goal counts already present in cycle_002_match_statistics.csv; BTTS market odds not yet extracted from raw bookmaker feeds
markets.live_support: LIKELY -- BTTS odds are commonly quoted live, same infrastructure as O/U2.5
limitations: Target (both teams score >=1) is trivially derivable from existing goal data, so no new acquisition needed for Stage A
Market odds extraction/aggregation code for BTTS does not yet exist and would need to be built (adapted from the O/U2.5 aggregation pipeline)
markets.next_action: Strong candidate for the next Stage-A-only cycle after O/U2.5. Target construction is nearly free (same match_statistics source); would need a new market-odds extraction step if a market-only model is desired.

markets.outcome_prediction_status: UNEXPLORED for outcome prediction (no AH-specific cycle run yet)
markets.betting_backtest_status: BLOCKED_BY_HISTORICAL_DATA -- cycle_002_consensus_ah.csv is 0 bytes (thin historical panel, same limitation as O/U2.5); additionally lines vary match-to-match so different handicap lines must never be merged
markets.live_support: LIKELY -- AH odds commonly quoted live
limitations: Handicap line varies by match (e.g. -0.5, -1.0, -1.5) -- lines must be modelled separately or handled with a line-relative target, adding real complexity versus a fixed binary target like O/U2.5 or BTTS
Historical panel thin, same as O/U2.5
More implementation complexity than O/U2.5 or BTTS for a first cycle
markets.next_action: Defer until after BTTS. Requires a line-handling design decision (per-line modelling or line-relative feature) before a Stage A cycle can start cleanly.

markets.outcome_prediction_status: EXHAUSTED for the features already tried (edge-hunting workstream)
markets.betting_backtest_status: PARTIALLY_EXPLORED -- Phase 3's own top nomination for a future money-qualification cycle, not yet executed
markets.data_family: tennis match-level features + Match Winner market odds (multiple data sources acquired across cycles 1-2)
markets.betting_overlay_status: PARTIALLY_EXPLORED -- Phase 3 nominated this as a strong candidate for a money-qualification backtest cycle but it has not yet been executed
markets.live_support: LIVE -- production already includes tennis in the scan
limitations: Substantially researched already; do not default back to it without a genuinely new question (per Phase 4 Section 5)
13 candidate edge features already rejected in Workstream B
markets.next_action: Do not reopen for outcome-prediction discovery. The open item is the money-qualification/betting-backtest cycle Phase 3 nominated -- pick this up only when the project is ready to run a Stage B-focused cycle rather than another Stage A discovery pass.

limitations: No data source has been acquired or audited for any sport outside football and tennis
markets.next_action: Out of scope until the football/tennis portfolio (1X2, O/U2.5, BTTS, AH) is further along. No action this cycle.

selection_history.reason: Highest combination of sample size (5,800 matches, 99.3% feature coverage), lowest implementation complexity (binary target, existing binary-outcome tooling directly reusable), full research independence from the exhausted 1X2 question, live compatibility, and calibration feasibility -- all per the criteria in Phase 4 Section 18, explicitly not chosen for perceived historical profitability. BTTS and AH deferred (BTTS needs new market-odds extraction code; AH needs a line-handling design). Tennis deliberately not defaulted to per Section 5.
